budgets.start: monotonic root start before repository imports and experimental source/data/network/log I/O; interpreter/bootstrap loading explicitly outside experimental I/O
budgets.end: after all writes, seals, completion, stdout flush and final bounds
budgets.per_case_csv_file_limit: frames*1024 INCLUDING header; each data line <=1024 including newline
budgets.per_case_metrics_file_limit: frames*2048 including every newline; each record <=2048
budgets.feasibility: Implementation must prove exact category exclusivity,629-frame scientific scratch and own-writer reservations before execution. Toolchain temporary bytes are explicitly posthoc verified; no claim that RLIMIT_FSIZE or RLIMIT_NOFILE bounds aggregate creation.
budgets.scope: Unchanged512MiB closure includes all retained results, scientific case scratch, own-writer transient/failure/final files. Explicit separate toolchain workspace has lowered perprocess/perfile/time controls and posthoc total inventory, not an aggregate prewrite quota.

toolchain_temporary.acceptance_scope: posthoc logical-byte inventory after each external tool command and before selecting retained provenance; deleted or between-check transient peaks are not measured
toolchain_temporary.command_seconds: min(30, absolute phase deadline-now, absolute root deadline-now)
preconditions: requested hardlimits installed or fail closed
toolchain_temporary.overshoot_action: MEASUREMENT_INVALID on first detected overshoot; stop before retention or further command, preserve prefix, no silent cleanup to pass

main_worker_limits.source_of_smaller_limits: scientific child caps320F/640F and tool child16MiB supersede inherited file ceiling
main_worker_limits.inherited_lower_limits: never raised; record effective stricter limits and fail closed if required installation unavailable

supervisor_limits.lowering_order: fork from original inherited limits before independently lowering parent/worker hard limits; never try to raise an inherited lower hard limit

scientific_scratch_proof.stdout_stderr: pipes with separately prechecked bounded sink; no regular-file child logs
scientific_scratch_proof.dedup: only after measured equality and descriptor write; atomic rename transfers category without duplicate bytes
preconditions: unique empty real no-symlink target directories

supervision.main_worker_30_second_exception: one long-lived main experiment process isolated solely for external fail-stop supervision; not an additional DSP/analysis child or phase worker
supervision.launch: supervisor outside worker's fresh session/process group; fork worker then lower hardlimits separately
supervision.worker_descendants: all inherit same worker group; no start_new_session/process_group/group-changing preexec/shell job control; D7 launch paths never used
supervision.protocol: bounded sequence-numbered phase and command messages over private inherited IPC; supervisor validates ordered state and returns absolute deadlines; ACK required before protected phase I/O and command Popen; no phase transition with active command
supervision.deadline_immutability: root never resets; phase=min(start+300,root); command=min(start+30,phase,root); a later request cannot erase or extend an earlier active deadline
supervision.fatal_action: at first scheduled supervisor wake at or after earliest active deadline, SIGKILL entire worker group; no catchable timeout exception, graceful request or new cleanup allowance
supervision.after_expiry: no hashing, inventory, receipt rewrite, finalization or stdout write initiated after detected expiry; existing bounded PENDING/failure prefix retained
supervision.ordinary_failure: first failure may be recorded only while all existing deadlines remain live; no retries or replacement prefix
supervision.completion: last negative phase and root deadlines remain armed through final writes, seal/completion, bounded stdout drain/flush, worker exit and check for leftover descendants; missing terminal completion or leftover descendants prevents success
supervision.termination_limit: scheduler/kernel latency and already-issued kernel I/O can finish later; no instantaneous physical cessation guarantee
supervision.process_group_limit: reviewed known-tool launch requirement and runtime group assertions, not syscall confinement; snapshots cannot prove arbitrary code never escaped; unexpected descendants or detected escape fail stop and are reported
